description.value: Golden Swan Restaurant is a well-established Chinese seafood restaurant on Victoria Drive in Vancouver, operating since 1998 and now one of the most popular in the Greater Vancouver area. The restaurant spans over 300 seats and is known for award-winning dim sum prepared fresh daily, alongside signature dinner dishes like Alaska King Crab, live lobster, and Peking Duck. A touring cyclist looking for a substantial sit-down meal in East Vancouver would find a full lunch dim sum service as well as a dinner menu with extensive Chinese cuisine options.
